panels.gesture: Calm engaged speech with a slightly open mouth and attentive blue eyes; both hands held apart in a measured explanatory gesture, palms facing one another.
Thoughtful, brows gently drawn together, gaze slightly sideways; one hand supporting the bearded chin, the other supporting that elbow.
A restrained skeptical half-smile with one raised eyebrow; one arm folded across the torso, the other hand turned palm-up as if asking for clarification.
Mouth closed, perceptive steady gaze with a slight head incline; hands loosely clasped low in frame, composed upright posture.
Quiet serious counsel with sympathetic eyes; one hand angled beside his mouth, the other open and low to emphasize discretion, only a slight lean.
Noble confident public speech, mouth naturally open, brows lifted with conviction; one arm presented outward with a broad open palm, shoulders square.
A pleased respectful nod and small approving smile; one hand making a restrained open-fingered acknowledgment near shoulder height, no salute or props.
An apologetic but firm closed-mouth smile and slightly knit brows; one hand gently raised palm-out, the other held open at his waist, no aggression.
An amused intelligent side-glance, bright eyes and a witty half-grin; one index finger slightly lifted near the chest as if finishing a clever remark, other hand relaxed.
